newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JAN 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE JAN 27.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- French museums allegedly hold some 1,955 works of art taken from Jews during the German occupation of France, according to a report by national accounts auditing agency.

-- Air France chairman Christian Blanc launches a new three-year company plan to increase market share, cut costs and manage merger with former domestic airline Air Inter . Analysts expect Air France to post a 200-million-franc loss for 1996, and former Air Inter some 800 million. A return to profit is expected for March 1998.
-- Moulinex to avoid some 1,468 job cuts linked to restructuring plan through shorter work week and early retirement.
-- National accounts auditing agency criticises French water supply market and lack of competition.
